title: France Excellence Eiffel scholarship programme
organization: French Ministry for Europe and Foreign Affairs (managed by Campus France)
overview: French government scholarship for master's and PhD study in France. Students cannot apply themselves: a French university nominates candidates it has admitted.
program_dates: Study period must begin between 1 September and 30 November of the award year; up to 12 months (Master 2), 24 months (Master 1) or 36 months (engineering degree)
deadline_text: Session 2027 (official French page, updated 2 October 2026): 'Ouverture de l'appel à candidature : 2 octobre 2026'; 'Date limite de dépôt par les établissements des dossiers de candidatures auprès de Campus France : mercredi 6 janvier 2027 inclus'; results 'courant de la semaine du 12 avril 2027'. This deadline applies to French institutions; students must meet each institution's earlier internal deadline ('ce calendrier ne concerne pas les étudiants qui doivent se rapprocher des établissements français pour connaître leur date limite').
funding_details: Master's level: monthly allowance of EUR 1,200 (from January 2026)
Doctoral level: EUR 2,000 per month on the implementation page

Tuition: recipients of French government scholarships are exempt from tuition charges for national diplomas (master, doctorate) or accredited engineering degrees in public institutions; 'Except as set forth above, program costs are not covered'
Airfare in the least-expensive class, reimbursed on receipts up to 50% of the Ministry's maximum rate for the country; return flight depends on academic results
Domestic travel to the academic location can be reimbursed; health insurance and housing assistance are provided
stipend: EUR 1,200 per month at master's level
eligibility: Applications are submitted exclusively by French higher-education institutions
Encourages applicants up to 29 years old at master's level and up to 35 at PhD level
Applications sent directly by students or by foreign institutions are ineligible
age_requirement: Up to 29 years old at master's level
education_requirement: Admission to a French master's or doctoral programme in a priority field
application_process: Apply for admission to a French master's programme
Ask that institution's international relations office about its Eiffel nomination and internal deadline
The institution submits the file to Campus France

sources.label: Programme Eiffel, session 2027 calendar (Campus France, French)

eligibility_reason: The age limit of 29 at master's level fits an applicant under 30. Everything else depends on being admitted to a French master's programme whose university agrees to nominate the candidate.
potential_issues: The university applies, not the student
Internal university deadlines fall well before the 6 January 2027 Campus France deadline
Tuition is waived only for national diplomas at public institutions; other programme costs are not covered
Airfare reimbursement is capped at 50% of the Ministry's maximum rate
benefits: French-taught options suit a French speaker
relevance_reason: French-language study removes the English-test barrier, and management is among the fields French universities nominate for.
upfront_cost_risk: Tuition and registration fees stay with the student.
action: The 2027 call is open: apply now for admission to two or three French master's programmes and ask each international office for its internal Eiffel deadline, which will fall before 6 January 2027.
notes: The English programme page still showed the 2026 campaign on 12 October 2026; the French page (updated 2 October 2026) carries the 2027 calendar. The French page lists the institutions' webinar as 'mercredi 4 novembre 2027', probably a typo for 2026. Implementation page links 'Regulations Eiffel 2027'.

Free dormitory place, or HUF 40,000 per month (about EUR 100) toward accommodation
Health care under Hungarian legislation plus supplementary medical insurance up to HUF 65,000 per year

stipend: HUF 43,700 per month (about EUR 110) at master's level
eligibility: Citizens of sending partners; 'Democratic Republic of the Congo' appears on the official partner list
